a.lede: OpenAI's newest cybersecurity model comes out as AI labs face scrutiny of their work to protect digital infrastructure.
a.title: OpenAI released a new cybersecurity model. Is that enough?

b.lede: An experiment in which AI models were asked to break into simulated networks showed the hacking skills of DeepSeek and GLM to be not far behind OpenAI’s most advanced cyber model, which isn’t public.
b.title: Free Chinese AI Models Are Getting Scary Good at Hacking
